title: Lightweight VDF Parser
outcome_summary: Replaced the direct `Gameloop.Vdf` dependency with a bounded internal parser for Steam's `libraryfolders.vdf` text format. Steam discovery retains its existing registry lookup, fallback order, path normalization, first-match behavior, installation validation, and silent failure boundary while parser grammar is independently tested.
project_summary: This project replaces the external Gameloop.Vdf dependency with a small project-owned parser for the Steam libraryfolders.vdf file used during Starfield installation discovery. It preserves existing Steam detection behavior and its silent fallback policy while removing the vulnerable package chain and adding targeted verification.
